name: Penzberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Penzberg (a white lamb with a flag on blue under a chequy chief with crossed hammers).
history: The arms were resolved by the city council on 28 November 1919 and approved by the Bavarian State Ministry of the Interior on 16 December 1929; the city bears a flag and a banner in black and red.

features.role: Penzberg arms — lamb with flag, chequy chief
